name: Morocco

flag.description: A red field with a green interlaced five-pointed star, drawn as an outline, in the center.
flag.symbolism: Red is associated with the ruling Alaouite dynasty and bravery; the green star, the Seal of Solomon, is linked to Islam and its five pillars.

hook: Morocco is red with a green star drawn as an interlaced outline; Vietnam's red flag has a solid yellow star.
trivia: The green star was added in 1915 to the plain red flag previously flown by the sultans.
The University of al-Qarawiyyin in Fez, founded in 859, is often cited as the oldest continuously operating university in the world.
